_comment_physics: Long-run dendrite config: moderate undercooling (delta = 0.7) and strong cubic anisotropy (epsilon = 0.15 > 1/15, where the unregularised equation is ill-posed, so willmore_beta > 0 is required). willmore_beta = 0.401 = |S| l*^2 with S = (1 + eps)(1 - 15 eps) = -1.4375 and the corner length l* = 0.528 W0 (docs/THEORY.md section 4.3).
_comment_grid: 192^3 = 7.08M points, box 76.4 W0. Measured on an RTX 4090: 0.71 GiB of GPU memory (108.1 bytes per cell with willmore_beta > 0), 113 MB per checkpoint, up to 88 MB per .vts.
_comment_time: Euler with the linearly implicit Willmore step. dt = 0.0003125 is the largest dt whose time error does not exceed the spatial error at h = 0.4 (docs/THEORY.md section 4.3); the explicit thermal update is stable below 0.0261. max_steps = 960000 (t = 300) is an upper bound: exit_on_saturation stops the run cleanly, with a final checkpoint and VTK frame, once phi > saturation_threshold on a boundary slab (measured: step 113600, t = 35.5, when the six <100> tips reach the walls). 14.4 ms per step on an RTX 4090: 27 minutes to saturation.
_comment_output: VTK every 8000 steps (2.5 time units): 16 frames up to saturation, 1.0 GB.
_comment_checkpoint: Checkpoint every 48000 steps (15 time units, 11.6 minutes of compute on an RTX 4090), keep_last = 3 (340 MB). The resume target picks the latest intact checkpoint.
